summary: Family foundry (240 staff, EUR 34.2 M, solid equity 38.5 %); we are only 1.4 % of its turnover but spend grew 30 %. Owner-led, expects partnership for the 2022 favour. Impeller HN 200 sells below its full cost (co-sourced 70 % with 70140, 70190 qualified); HN 250 is sole-sourced with no should-cost. Delivery is slipping badly (OTD 74.5 %, two amber quarters). It is invited to the HX 80-200 RFQ against Tarsevi: our best lever.
notes: Expects partnership for the 2022 favour; the HX 80-200 RFQ (4200 pc/yr) is new volume we can offer. Fears losing HN 200 share to 70140/70190. Risk: we pay late (52 % of invoices over 5 days late), it may raise that. No price letter or cost claim on file.
fears: losing the new HX 80-200 business to Tarsevi

evidence.quote: in 2022 they kept supplying at the old price for a quarter and said he expects partnership in return.

tactics: Lead with the delivery scorecard: two amber quarters and OTD falling to 74.5 %.
Link price to the HX 80-200 RFQ: competitive pricing now helps its HX quote.
Push HN 250 harder than HN 200; HN 200 is already below its cost.
Offer a binding volume or HN 200 quota from 70140 for a visible price step.
Do not offer faster payment as a gift; fix our late payments only if it raises them.
